actual.titulo: People Magazine Investigates: The University of Cosmic Intelligence Cult
actual.descripcion: Rashad Jamal rises online as a self-proclaimed prophet, creating a cult that mixes cosmic teachings with conspiracy. His University of Cosmic Intelligence spreads fast, but when some of his followers vanish, fear grows that devotion has turned deadly.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • The Box on Her Doorstep
lista.descripcion: The Box on Her Doorstep | Teenager Sarah Garone is targeted by an anonymous predator for nearly a decade; each time, Sarah turns to her stepfather, Gary Hardy, for protection, not realizing he is the one determined to hurt her.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • I Should Have Killed Him Myself
lista.descripcion: I Should Have Killed Him Myself | John Duck spends his entire life fearing the day his brother Kevin would finally kill someone, but when John discovers his brother is actually a murderer, he still isn't ready to face that Kevin had been born a killer.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • It Was All Judith
lista.descripcion: It Was All Judith | As a child, Corey Breininger's stepmother, Judith Hawkey, coerces him into doing something horrible; he keeps her deadly secret for years, too afraid to tell anyone the truth.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • The Werewolf Butcher
lista.descripcion: The Werewolf Butcher | Jack Roy Spillman starts collecting wolf memorabilia, and his sisters think it's an odd hobby; when they learn of horrific things he's done, they realize some people may have been right when they called him more animal than human.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • I Raised a Sociopath
lista.descripcion: I Raised a Sociopath | Robert Foust contemplates killing his son, Aaron, as the only way to prevent Aaron from becoming a murderer; instead, Robert chooses to put himself and his son in God's hands, and God's plan makes him question everything.

lista.titulo: Evil Lives Here • My Love Put a Gun to My Head

lista.titulo: A Body in the Basement • Conditional Love

lista.descripcion: Mission Critical | In Maryland, a high-speed chase erupts when a serial dangerous driver strikes again, putting one officer's life in grave danger; in Georgia, police hunt a bank robber, and in Wisconsin, a gunfight breaks out when a lone officer confronts an armed man.
